LOAD DATA

# Load corrected microbiome ∩ diet ∩ WGS
# object (103 birds)
microb_overlap_otu <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir,
    "/wgs_microb_corrected.rds")) %>%
    biomeUtils::removeZeros()

# Add TipID column for tree-matching
sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$TipID_microbiome <- paste(sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Lab_Code,
    sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Species_Label,
    sep = "_")

# Diet object (already overlap-filtered)
diet_fr <- readRDS(paste0(dataDir, "/diet_overlap_microb_corrected.rds"))

# Generate per-taxonomic-level glommed
# objects
tax_levels <- c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family",
    "Genus", "Species", "OTU99")

ps_by_level <- lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
    if (lvl == "OTU99")
        microb_overlap_otu else speedyseq::tax_glom(microb_overlap_otu,
        lvl)
})
names(ps_by_level) <- tax_levels

# Sanity check
sapply(ps_by_level, function(x) nrow(sample_data(x)))

GEOGRAPHIC DISTANCE

my_points <- data.frame(longitude = sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Xdec,
    latitude = sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Ydec,
    Island_Mainland = sample_data(microb_overlap_otu)$Island_Mainland,
    row.names = sample_names(microb_overlap_otu))

dist_mat <- distm(cbind(my_points$longitude, my_points$latitude),
    fun = distGeo)/1000
rownames(dist_mat) <- rownames(my_points)
colnames(dist_mat) <- rownames(my_points)
geo_dist <- as.dist(dist_mat)
lgeo_dist <- as.dist(log10(geo_dist + 1))

MICROBIOME DISTANCES

# Helper that returns Bray, Jaccard, and
# UniFrac distances for one phyloseq object,
# with rows in the same order as dist_mat
compute_dists <- function(ps, sample_order) {
    # Reorder samples to match dist_mat
    ps_ordered <- prune_samples(sample_order,
        ps)
    tab <- otu_table(ps_ordered)

    # Ensure OTU table has samples as rows
    # for vegdist
    if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_ordered)) {
        tab_matrix <- as.matrix(tab)
    } else {
        tab_matrix <- t(as.matrix(tab))
    }

    list(bray = vegdist(tab_matrix, method = "bray"),
        jaccard = vegdist(tab_matrix, method = "jaccard",
            binary = TRUE), unifrac_uw = UniFrac(ps_ordered,
            weighted = FALSE), unifrac_w = UniFrac(ps_ordered,
            weighted = TRUE))
}

# Compute distances for all taxonomic levels
microb_dists <- lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
    message("Computing distances for: ", lvl)
    compute_dists(ps_by_level[[lvl]], sample_order = rownames(dist_mat))
})
names(microb_dists) <- tax_levels

DIET DISTANCES

diet_overlap <- prune_samples(sample_names(diet_fr) %in%
    sample_names(microb_overlap_otu), diet_fr)
diet_overlap <- prune_samples(rownames(dist_mat),
    diet_overlap)

diet_tab <- otu_table(diet_overlap)
if (taxa_are_rows(diet_overlap)) {
    diet_tab <- t(diet_tab)
}

diet_bray_dist <- vegdist(diet_tab, method = "bray")
diet_jaccard_dist <- vegdist(diet_tab, method = "jaccard",
    binary = TRUE)
diet_rc_dist <- raupcrick(diet_tab)

HOST PHYLOGENETIC DISTANCE

fringilla_tree <- read.tree(file = paste0(dataDir,
    "/mt_Fringilla_aln.fasta.contree"))
fringilla_tree$tip.label <- gsub("_mtDNA", "",
    fringilla_tree$tip.label)

annot <- read_delim(paste0(dataDir, "/WGS_Fringilla_samples.tsv"))

# Rename tree tips to match microbiome IDs
fringilla_tree$tip.label <- annot[match(fringilla_tree$tip.label,
    annot$WGS_ID), ]$TipID_microbiome

microb_overlap_meta <- data.frame(sample_data(microb_overlap_otu))

# Subset tree to matching IDs
fringilla_tree_subset <- as.treedata.table(tree = fringilla_tree,
    data = microb_overlap_meta, name_column = "TipID_microbiome")$phy

fringilla_rootedtree <- root(fringilla_tree_subset,
    outgroup = "149_Tenerife_F_teydea", resolve.root = TRUE)

# Host distance matrix in same row order as
# dist_mat
host_dist_full <- cophenetic.phylo(fringilla_tree_subset)
host_dist <- as.dist(host_dist_full[rownames(dist_mat),
    colnames(dist_mat)])

MANTEL TEST HELPER

# Distance metric names for iteration
dist_metrics <- c("bray", "jaccard", "unifrac_uw",
    "unifrac_w")
dist_labels <- c("Bray-Curtis", "Jaccard", "Unweighted UniFrac",
    "Weighted UniFrac")
names(dist_labels) <- dist_metrics

# Runs simple Mantel test for one microbiome
# distance and one predictor distance
mantel_pair <- function(microb_dist, predictor_dist,
    taxon, dist_name) {
    m_simple <- vegan::mantel(microb_dist, predictor_dist,
        method = "pearson", permutations = 9999)

    data.frame(taxonomy = taxon, dist = dist_name,
        r = round(m_simple$statistic, 4), p = m_simple$signif)
}

# Run mantel_pair across all 7 taxonomic
# levels for all 4 distance metrics
mantel_across_levels <- function(predictor_dist) {
    bind_rows(lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
        bind_rows(lapply(dist_metrics, function(metric) {
            mantel_pair(microb_dists[[lvl]][[metric]],
                predictor_dist, lvl, dist_labels[metric])
        }))
    }))
}

MANTEL: GEOGRAPHIC DISTANCE

# Just simple Mantel (no partial here, since
# geo IS the control variable)
mantel_geo_simple <- function(microb_dist, taxon,
    dist_name) {
    m <- vegan::mantel(microb_dist, lgeo_dist,
        method = "pearson", permutations = 9999)
    data.frame(taxonomy = taxon, dist = dist_name,
        r = round(m$statistic, 4), p = m$signif)
}

mantel_out_geo <- bind_rows(lapply(tax_levels,
    function(lvl) {
        bind_rows(lapply(dist_metrics, function(metric) {
            mantel_geo_simple(microb_dists[[lvl]][[metric]],
                lvl, dist_labels[metric])
        }))
    }))

mantel_out_geo <- mantel_out_geo %>%
    mutate(p = round(p, 4))

write.csv(mantel_out_geo, paste0(dataDir, "/output_mantel_geo.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE)

kable(mantel_out_geo %>%
    filter(taxonomy == "Species"), caption = "Mantel test: Geographic distance (Species level)") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped",
        "hover", "condensed"))

MRM AND VARIANCE PARTITIONING

# Distance metrics for MRM (UniFrac excluded
# — results consistent, reduces complexity)
mrm_metrics <- c("bray", "jaccard")
mrm_labels <- c("Bray-Curtis", "Jaccard")
names(mrm_labels) <- mrm_metrics

# Variance partitioning for one microbiome
# distance, with host/diet/geo predictors
varpart_one <- function(microb_dist, taxon, dist_name,
    diet_dist = diet_rc_dist) {
    full <- MRM(microb_dist ~ host_dist + diet_dist +
        lgeo_dist, nperm = 9999)
    m_host <- MRM(microb_dist ~ host_dist, nperm = 9999)
    m_geo <- MRM(microb_dist ~ lgeo_dist, nperm = 9999)
    m_diet <- MRM(microb_dist ~ diet_dist, nperm = 9999)
    m_hd <- MRM(microb_dist ~ host_dist + diet_dist,
        nperm = 9999)
    m_hg <- MRM(microb_dist ~ host_dist + lgeo_dist,
        nperm = 9999)
    m_dg <- MRM(microb_dist ~ diet_dist + lgeo_dist,
        nperm = 9999)

    H <- m_host$r.squared[1]
    G <- m_geo$r.squared[1]
    D <- m_diet$r.squared[1]
    HD <- m_hd$r.squared[1]
    HG <- m_hg$r.squared[1]
    DG <- m_dg$r.squared[1]
    total <- full$r.squared[1]

    vp <- varPart(A = H, B = D, C = G, AB = HD,
        AC = HG, BC = DG, ABC = total, A.name = "host",
        B.name = "diet", C.name = "geo")
    vp$pop_ind <- "Individual"
    vp$distance <- dist_name
    vp$tax <- taxon
    vp$variable <- rownames(vp)
    vp
}
# Run varpart across all 7 taxonomic levels
# × 2 distance metrics (Bray & Jaccard)
varpart_results <- bind_rows(lapply(tax_levels,
    function(lvl) {
        message("Running varpart at level: ",
            lvl)
        bind_rows(lapply(mrm_metrics, function(metric) {
            varpart_one(microb_dists[[lvl]][[metric]],
                lvl, mrm_labels[metric])
        }))
    }))

# Set negative proportions to 0 and convert
# to percent
varpart_results$Proportion <- pmax(varpart_results$Proportion,
    0)
varpart_results$percent <- round(varpart_results$Proportion *
    100, 2)
varpart_results$tax <- factor(varpart_results$tax,
    levels = c("OTU99", "Species", "Genus", "Family",
        "Order", "Class", "Phylum"))

write.csv(varpart_results, paste0(dataDir, "/output_varpart.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE)

kable(varpart_results %>%
    filter(tax == "Species") %>%
    select(distance, variable, percent), caption = "Variance partitioning (Species level)") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped",
        "hover", "condensed"))

MRM FULL MODEL RESULTS

# Extract full MRM model coefficients for
# all taxonomic levels and distance metrics
# Includes individual R² for each predictor
# from single-predictor models
mrm_full_one <- function(microb_dist, taxon, dist_name,
    diet_dist = diet_rc_dist) {
    full <- MRM(microb_dist ~ host_dist + diet_dist +
        lgeo_dist, nperm = 9999)
    m_host <- MRM(microb_dist ~ host_dist, nperm = 9999)
    m_diet <- MRM(microb_dist ~ diet_dist, nperm = 9999)
    m_geo <- MRM(microb_dist ~ lgeo_dist, nperm = 9999)

    coefs <- data.frame(full$coef)
    coefs$predictor <- rownames(coefs)
    coefs$taxonomy <- taxon
    coefs$distance <- dist_name
    coefs$R2_full <- full$r.squared[1]
    coefs$F_stat <- full$F.test[1]
    coefs$F_p <- full$F.test[2]

    # Add individual R² for each predictor
    coefs$R2_individual <- NA
    coefs$R2_individual[coefs$predictor == "host_dist"] <- m_host$r.squared[1]
    coefs$R2_individual[coefs$predictor == "diet_dist"] <- m_diet$r.squared[1]
    coefs$R2_individual[coefs$predictor == "lgeo_dist"] <- m_geo$r.squared[1]

    coefs %>%
        rename(estimate = microb_dist, p_value = pval) %>%
        dplyr::select(taxonomy, distance, predictor,
            estimate, p_value, R2_individual,
            R2_full, F_stat, F_p)
}

mrm_results <- bind_rows(lapply(tax_levels, function(lvl) {
    message("Running MRM at level: ", lvl)
    bind_rows(lapply(mrm_metrics, function(metric) {
        mrm_full_one(microb_dists[[lvl]][[metric]],
            lvl, mrm_labels[metric])
    }))
}))

mrm_results <- mrm_results %>%
    mutate(estimate = round(estimate, 5), R2_individual = round(R2_individual,
        4), R2_full = round(R2_full, 4), F_stat = round(F_stat,
        2), p_value = round(p_value, 4), F_p = round(F_p,
        4))

write.csv(mrm_results, paste0(dataDir, "/output_mrm_full.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE)

kable(mrm_results %>%
    filter(taxonomy == "Species"), caption = "MRM full model results (Species level)") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped",
        "hover", "condensed"))
